Digital Product Manager Job at Learn Africa Plc




        
    

        
        Learn Africa Plc is a leading learning resource business with a history spanning over 60 years. The company was established in 1961 as Longman Nigeria - a book publishing firm wholly owned by Longman Group UK Limited, now Pearson Education. On July 23, 1996, the shares of Longman Nigeria Plc were listed on the Nigerian Stock Exchange. In 2008, the company became a subsidiary of Pearson Plc following the latter's increase in its shareholding from 29 to 51 percent. In 2011, however, Pearson and Longman Nigeria mutually agreed to become separate corporate entities in Nigeria.
     

            
    



The main business of Learn Africa Plc is the publication and marketing of textbooks for the entire gamut of the educational system - nursery, primary, secondary and tertiary. Today, the company has the widest range of books/educational resources and a very expansive distribution network in Nigeria.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Digital Product Manager
Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities


	Drive the digital product strategy and roadmap.
	Translate customer and business needs into scalable digital solutions.
	Work with editorial, sales, marketing and technology teams to deliver high-impact products.
	Monitor product performance and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
	Identify and integrate Al-powered tools and technologies to improve product development, user experience, content delivery, and business processes.


Requirements


	Minimum of 5 years of experience in product management, EdTech, SaaS, media technology, e-commerce, or digital product delivery.
	Strong understanding of product lifecycle management and user-centred design.
	Experience with product management and analytics tools is an advantage.
	Demonstrable knowledge of Artificial Intelligence (Al) tools, trends, and their practical application in digital product management and educational technology is essential.
	Candidates should be able to leverage Al to drive innovation, improve decision-making, and enhance customer experience.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: If you are passionate about transforming education through technology, we would like to hear from you.

Administrative Executive Job at Emel Corporate Solutions (ECS) Limited




        
    

        
        Emel Corporate Solutions (ECS) Limited, established in 2009, is a leading provider of world class, purpose-to-fit solutions to the growing B2B sector in West Africa. Our founders have over fifty years’ experience of running diverse businesses in the country. ECS has the passion, creativity, experience and dedication to assist our clients to achieve sustainable business growth. Our impeccable reputation makes us the ideal expert to partner with to add value to any business.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Administrative Executive

Job Location: Isolo, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Executive to support the smooth execution of business operations.
	The successful candidate will coordinate administrative activities across sales, finance, and operations while ensuring timely processing of documentation, orders, payments, and compliance requirements.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage Purchase Orders (POs) and maintain accurate business documentation.
	Coordinate with vendors on order execution, deliveries, and payment processing.
	Follow up with clients on payments, collections, and account reconciliations.
	Prepare and issue invoices while ensuring alignment between Purchase Orders, invoices, and delivery records.
	Manage vendor registration, compliance documentation, and contract records.
	Provide day-to-day administrative support and facilitate collaboration between Sales, Finance, and Operations.
	Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance operational efficiency.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Accounting, or a related field.
	2–4 years of experience in an administrative, operations, or office support role.
	Excellent organizational and time management skills.
	Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
	High attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, and Outlook).
	Ability to multitask, prioritize effectively, and maintain confidentiality.


What We're Looking For
The ideal candidate is:


	Proactive and self-motivated.
	Highly organized and detail-oriented.
	Comfortable working across multiple functions.
	Skilled at building positive relationships with clients and vendors.
	Committed to operational excellence.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using "Administrative Executive" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Accountant Job at TASCK Creative Company Limited




        
    

        
        TASCK Creative Company Limited - We represent talented creatives and help them build meaningful careers that will be beneficial to themselves and to society. We invest in platforms and technology that improve the creative ecosystem so that we can facilitate meaningful value creating partnerships.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	Do you have a strong passion for building financial systems that scale and a proven ability to manage accounting in fast-growing, multi-stream businesses?
	We are seeking a highly skilled and systems-driven Accountant to join TASCK. In this role, you will go beyond traditional accounting to design and manage the financial infrastructure that supports a dynamic, tech-enabled business operating across subscriptions, partnerships, commissions, and platform-based revenue models.
	This is a key role within the organisation, offering the opportunity to shape financial systems, improve operational efficiency, and provide insights that directly support strategic decision-making and growth.


Here's What You'll Do


	Build and Manage Financial Systems: Design and maintain scalable accounting structures that support multiple revenue streams, ensuring accuracy, transparency, and efficiency across all financial operations.
	Oversee Financial Operations: Manage bookkeeping, reconciliations, reporting, budgeting, cash flow, and financial controls to ensure strong financial discipline and visibility.
	Drive Financial Planning & Insights: Develop financial models, forecasts, and budgets that support business growth and inform strategic decisions.
	Manage Payment & Revenue Flows: Oversee billing systems, payment processes, revenue recognition, and reconciliation across digital platforms and subscription models.
	Ensure Compliance & Governance Maintain accurate records, ensure tax and statutory compliance, and support audit processes.
	Improve Systems & Processes: Implement and optimise digital accounting tools, financial workflows, and reporting systems to improve efficiency and scalability.


Requirements
Are you the ideal candidate?


	You hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (professional certification such as ICAN, ACCA, or CPA is strongly preferred).
	You have 4–8 years of progressive accounting experience, including at least 3 years in a startup, tech, or platform-based environment.
	You have strong experience with financial modelling, budgeting, reporting, and cash flow management.
	You understand subscription-based or multi-stream revenue models and digital payment systems.
	You are highly proficient with accounting software (e.g., QuickBooks, Xero, Zoho Books, Sage), Excel/Google Sheets, and financial reporting tools.
	You are analytical, detail-oriented, systems-driven, and comfortable working in fast-paced, evolving environments.





What We Offer


	Salary: N800,000 / month.
	A competitive salary and benefits package
	The opportunity to shape financial systems in a high-growth organisation
	A dynamic and collaborative work environment
	Exposure to innovative, tech-enabled business models
	If you're a strategic and passionate Accountant, we encourage you to apply!
